name: landcover
note: Phase 3 land-cover head (Track A, ckpt_step_2814), per (patch, class) decision on the official BigEarthNet test shard: does the head's own sigmoid confidence rank its correct calls above its incorrect ones. The deployed v3 head (landcover_full) has not been re-scored here. The deployed tool reports the mean calibrated probability of the classes it asserts as its confidence and abstains per class below its decision threshold (configs/thresholds.v3.yaml).
